name: Vellis Duskfin
source_profile: ● Vellis Duskfin (LG) is the Namaris trade representative. Vellis maintains longstanding relationships with the Thalenweald and several independent frontier merchants. He opposes indiscriminate raiding and fears that continued attacks will invite devastating retaliation from the crown.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 71 (source excerpt; may be partial)
